sufficiency_note: Development starting material only. Qualify each new asset component and its scope independently.

original_inputs: C18 versioned handoff/reference; real acceptance requires its delivered input

original_acceptance: Every state includes its field, policy revision, evaluation time and evidence reasons.
No single score silently converts incomplete evidence into a clean observation.
Reviewed cases justify freshness assumptions and disclose the unsupported profiles.
Every listed artifact exists or has an agreed equivalent path, and an independent reviewer can reproduce the documented procedure.
Record actual tests, input/configuration revisions and unresolved failures; planned/reference examples do not establish completion.

asset_research_plan.decision: Implement a versioned, explainable asset-evidence policy that reports which fields are usable, stale, missing or conflicting at an explicit evaluation time.
questions: Which freshness windows and mandatory fields are defensible for each supported asset/collection profile?
How will original collection time, clock uncertainty, partial failure and conflicting observations change usability?
How can consumers inspect the exact reasons instead of relying on an uncalibrated confidence percentage?
asset_research_plan.comparison: Compare simple latest-snapshot/age-only baselines against reviewed stale/partial/conflict cases.
cases: Reimport old data and retain its age; evaluate identically with a fixed as_of time.
Preserve unknown/conflict/time_uncertain under missing timestamps and skew.
A successful collection of one field must not mark every other field fresh or complete.
consumers: C20: field-level gaps/staleness that justify bounded collection probes.
C22/C23: quality states and source coverage for evaluation/relationship qualification.
C13/D09 reviewers: explicit usability reasons; matching and closure decisions remain with their existing components.
asset_research_plan.reviewers: Mahrous checks how evidence usability is consumed by matching/verification without changing their authority.
asset_research_plan.start: Post-first-slice: complete C18, C03 first; draft research/fixtures earlier without claiming measured completion.
